content: Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Storage Instructions: Store the medication in a refrigerator. Do not freeze the medication. Keep the medication in its original carton to protect it from light. If necessary, the medication may also be stored at room temperature. However, if stored at room temperature, do not return it to the refrigerator and discard it after 30 days. Discard any unused portion of the medication after use. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed.
